title: Communication Codes (Michelle Grogan)
style: funk-rnb-reggaeton-cumbia-dnb fusion 132bpm slap bass Rhodes sax horns dembow marimba guiro congas dnb chorus beatbox claps English Spanish coach calls
lyrics:
[Intro]
Signal behind the back
Open palm or closed fist
Talk before every point
Team moves as one

[Verse 1]
Open palm I am switching sides
Closed fist I am staying home
Finger one I serve down the line
Finger two I serve cross court
Vamos vamos partner ready
Uno dos tres signal steady
Talk talk talk every point
Team codes anoint

[Pre-Chorus]
Call it call it
Mine yours mine yours
Call it call it
Open the doors

[Chorus]
Communication codes communication codes
Mine yours switch you switch me
Communication codes communication codes
Vamos partners we agree

[Verse 2]
Mid court ball call it loud
Deep middle call it proud
Bounce or no bounce call it clear
Leave or take say it dear
Uno dos tres signal switch
Mano blanda no glitch
After every point we plan
Next serve next return next stand

[Bridge]
Silent team is a beat team
Loud team is a peak team
Three words minimum each rally
Mine yours leave the alley

[Chorus]
Communication codes communication codes
Mine yours switch you switch me
Communication codes communication codes
Vamos partners we agree

[Outro]
Call it loud call it clear
Call it call it partner near
Call it loud call it clear
We are a team here
